experiment_receipt.scope: Archived experiment integrity and arithmetic; participant failures are measurements, not CI failures.

serialization_compatibility.compatibility_policy: Only operation=doc with three arguments: canonical positive decimal strings in original argv may remain identical strings or serialize as equal positive integers at indexes 1 and 2. All other arguments preserve both JSON type and value; booleans and floats are rejected.
serialization_compatibility.mechanism: The frozen Perl recorder stores a reference to argv in each event. Its doc range comparison and arithmetic set numeric flags on the existing scalar values; JSON::PP subsequently emits those line numbers as JSON integers. The archived request and event represent the same document and line-number values. Neither archive is rewritten.

independent_consistency_receipt.scope: evidence consistency; does not prove model independence or completeness of platform telemetry

scope_notes: Linux x86_64 runs the complete Debug and Release Cargo suites, frozen conformance and six-target cross-build checks.
Windows x86_64 and macOS arm64 run the explicitly selected native suite. Their 71/74 counts are not a claim of full Linux-equivalent conformance.
The single ignored Cargo test is the legacy exploratory p0::conformance_report; the active frozen conformance suite executes on Linux.

Independent GCC ASan+UBSan passes 60 exported P0 run/panic programs and clean/use-after-free/overflow capability probes. LeakSanitizer is disabled and YV_ALLOC_CHECK is enabled; pinned Zig ASan conformance remains unsupported.

The experiment gate validates the archive and arithmetic. The language submissions were executed on the server against frozen compiler inputs; CI does not rerun participant code using the current compiler.
Round-five model token usage, exact model/sampling provenance and total platform tool calls remain unavailable. Recorded lab requests are a separate observed metric.
All five jobs and artifacts refer to the same validation revision; no cross-revision successes are combined.
verification_method: Fetched final run/jobs/artifacts from GitHub API; downloaded each artifact ZIP; matched bytes and SHA-256 against the API digest; parsed embedded native, sanitizer and experiment reports and independently checked their identities and exact totals.
